engineering.details: Existing signed fixed-head Darcy model retained unchanged; direction and metrics are consumed by the renderer.

functionality.details: Source covers validated parameter changes, direction reversal, deterministic update, reset/snapshot/resize and cleanup.

animation.details: Representative straight tracks animate deterministically in the computed signed direction and disappear at zero gradient.

spatial3d.details: Real Three.js soil prism, reservoirs, boundaries and flow tracks implemented; rendered comparison unavailable.

accessibility.details: Keyboard controls, text scope statements, metrics and reduced-motion-aware camera behavior implemented; AT check pending.

visual.details: Surveying-style scene framing, responsive HUD, camera staging and focus mode implemented in source; no rendered pass claimed.

reuse.details: Host scene/time ownership retained with exact Three.js peer and owned GPU resource disposal.
